description: Variation of Condition 2 (approved plans) attached to planning permission P/0288/22 dated 11.2.2022 to allow change of pitched roof to flat roof, side extension and raised patio with boundary treatment (amended description).
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of planning permission PL/2924/25 dated 06.01.2026.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

This permission shall have the effect of varying condition numbered 2 on approved application reference P/0288/22 dated 11/02/2022. The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: Site Location Plan, MAHMOODPLAN/001, MAHMOODPLAN/002, MAHMOODPLAN/003, MAHMOODPLAN/004
